searchText: Does anyone have a recommendation for a VPN server? Something that supports network sharing (meaning two routers in different locations would connect to the VPN server and it would "merge" the two networks. I currently use OpenVPN Access Server, but their licensing model is ridiculous and I need more simultaneous clients than the free version allows. Tailscale? https://tailscale.com/ Or wireguard (which Tailscale is based on) https://www.procustodibus.com/blog/2020/12/wireguard-site-to-site-config/ I use sshuttle for support and routinely have access to multiple remote networks from my at home desktop. https://github.com/sshuttle/sshuttle Then it's sudo sshuttle -v -r user@f.q.d.n:port 192.168.3.0/24 and I can access all 192.168.3.nnn
